requirements.title: Worktree management
requirements.description: List, create, and manage git worktrees via the WorktreeService Connect-RPC surface; expose worktree identity through RepoService.GetRepoStatus; cross-link branch list with checked_out_in_worktree.

validation.title: Worktree domain layer is seam-tested
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/internal/worktree/service_test.go covers List, Get, Identify, ClaimedBranches, Create (existing/new-branch/detached), Remove (refuses main, propagates NotFound, dispatches force), Lock/Unlock/Move/Prune through FakeInspector and FakeMutator. NO real git is invoked.

validation.title: WorktreeService Connect handler is exercised via httptest
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/handlers/worktree/connect_handler_test.go stands up an httptest.Server with FakeInspector/FakeMutator and asserts every RPC, including dry-run header behavior and InvalidArgument / NotFound code mapping.

validation.title: RepoService.GetRepoStatus exposes worktree identity (Tier 1)
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/handlers/repo/connect_handler_test.go and internal/repo/service_test.go cover linked-worktree, main-worktree, detached, and InvalidArgument cases against FakeInspector.

validation.title: Branch list cross-link populates checked_out_in_worktree
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/branch_worktree_test.go exercises enrichBranchesWithWorktreeClaims with a stubbed claimedBranchesFn — no real git.

validation.title: CLI worktree command group hits Connect-RPC only
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/cli/domains/worktree/handlers_test.go substitutes the WorktreeServiceClient seam (clientFactory) with a fakeClient and covers list/get/create/remove/lock/unlock/move/prune flag plumbing.

validation.title: Porcelain parser handles main/linked/detached/locked/prunable
validation.evidence: scenarios/git-control-tower/api/internal/worktree/parse_test.go tests parsePorcelain against fixed strings; no real git.
